Modal.notes: Static open markup: .modal__backdrop (div) > .modal__container (div) > section.modal__dialog[role=dialog][tabindex=-1][aria-labelledby=<heading id>] > .modal__header > h2.modal__heading[slot=title][id], .modal__body, .modal__footer. React portals them to <body>; the backdrop is position:fixed inset-0 z-50 so it can sit anywhere. Parts carry data-slot=modal-<part> (CSS does not select them). Trigger = div.modal__trigger[role=button][tabindex=0] (Pressable adds tabindex; DialogTrigger adds id, aria-expanded=false|true, aria-controls=<dialog id> while open; no aria-haspopup for dialog type). INLINE VAR: put style="--visual-viewport-height:100dvh" on .modal__backdrop (RAC sets it in px; container inherits it); backdrop and container use h-(--visual-viewport-height), without it the container shrinks to content and data-placement top/bottom and size cover/full break. (RAC also sets --visual-viewport-width/--page-width/--page-height, unused by CSS.) data-placement (auto default | top | center | bottom) must be written on BOTH .modal__container and .modal__dialog; dialog margins key on its own [data-placement] (auto: mt-auto sm:my-auto; center: my-auto; bottom: mt-auto; top: mt-0). size and scroll are Container props but React pushes the classes down via context, so write them on descendants: Dialog gets modal__dialog--<size> and modal__dialog--scroll-<inside|outside>; Body gets modal__body--scroll-<inside|outside>; Container gets modal__container--scroll-outside and, for size full, modal__container--full. Defaults apply even when props are omitted (size md, scroll inside): a default dialog carries modal__dialog--md modal__dialog--scroll-inside and the body carries modal__body--scroll-inside. variant lives on Backdrop (modal__backdrop--opaque default). CloseTrigger = HeroUI CloseButton: <button type=button class="close-button close-button--default modal__close-trigger" aria-label="Close" slot=close data-slot=modal-close-trigger><svg data-slot=close-button-icon viewBox="0 0 16 16" width=16 height=16 fill=none aria-hidden=true role=presentation><path d="M3.47 3.47a.75.75 0 0 1 1.06 0L8 6.94l3.47-3.47a.75.75 0 1 1 1.06 1.06L9.06 8l3.47 3.47a.75.75 0 1 1-1.06 1.06L8 9.06l-3.47 3.47a.75.75 0 0 1-1.06-1.06L6.94 8 3.47 4.53a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.06Z" fill=currentColor fill-rule=evenodd clip-rule=evenodd/></svg></button>; absolute top-4 right-4 inside the relative dialog. Modal.Icon is a plain div.modal__icon (size-10, flex-centered; no default svg, no color modifiers). data-entering/data-exiting="true" on backdrop/container only drive animation: omit for a static open dialog. Trigger focus ring works only via data-focus-visible="true" (the CSS selector :focus-visible:not(:focus) cannot match natively); pressed via :active or data-pressed. Not reproducible: scroll lock, focus trap, aria-hidden of siblings.

propTargets.size: Container (class lands on Dialog via context; 'full' also adds modal__container--full on Container)
propTargets.scroll: Container (classes land on Container, Dialog and Body via context)

Modal.openQuestions: size/scroll classes land on descendants (Dialog/Body/Container), not only on Container; modifierFor already lists the correct target blocks.

AlertDialog.notes:
Same overlay structure as Modal: .alert-dialog__backdrop > .alert-dialog__container > section.alert-dialog__dialog[role=alertdialog][tabindex=-1][aria-labelledby=] > .alert-dialog__header (> .alert-dialog__icon, h2.alert-dialog__heading[slot=title][id]), .alert-dialog__body, .alert-dialog__footer; parts carry data-slot=alert-dialog-. Trigger = div.alert-dialog__trigger[role=button][tabindex=0] (aria-expanded/aria-controls/id as for Modal). Differences from Modal: role=alertdialog; no scroll prop, no size full, no container modifier classes, no modal__icon; dialog is max-h-full overflow-clip and body is always overflow-y-auto. Put style="--visual-viewport-height:100dvh" on the backdrop (backdrop/container height depend on it, see Modal). data-placement (auto default | top | center | bottom) must be on BOTH container and dialog. size is a Container prop but its class lands on the Dialog via context (default md: write alert-dialog__dialog--md). variant is on Backdrop; status is on Icon, not on the root. Icon markup:
; the svg MUST carry data-slot=alert-dialog-default-icon (CSS box-content size-5). Default svg by status: default and accent = HeroUI Info icon, success = check-circle, warning = triangle-exclamation, danger (default status) = circle-exclamation; custom children replace it. Backdrop defaults isDismissable=false and keyboard dismiss disabled (behavior only). CloseTrigger: same CloseButton markup as Modal with class alert-dialog__close-trigger and data-slot=alert-dialog-close-trigger. The CSS rule .alert-dialog__header > .modal__icon is stale (never matches). data-entering/data-exiting on backdrop/container are animation-only (omit). Focus ring only via data-focus-visible="true".

propTargets.size: Container (class lands on Dialog via context)

Drawer.notes:
Static open markup (same nesting as Modal): .drawer__backdrop[data-slot=drawer-backdrop] > .drawer__content.drawer__content--[data-placement][data-slot=drawer-content] (fixed inset-0 z-50 flex pointer-events-none) > section.drawer__dialog.drawer__dialog--[data-placement][role=dialog][tabindex=-1][aria-labelledby][data-slot=drawer-dialog] > optional .drawer__handle, .drawer__header > h2.drawer__heading[slot=title][id], .drawer__body, .drawer__footer, close trigger. Portaled to . Because Content is a descendant of Backdrop, the backdrop opacity transition (opacity 0 under its data-entering/data-exiting) fades the panel too. placement (default bottom | top | left | right) is a Content prop but must be repeated: Content gets class drawer__content-- AND data-placement; Dialog gets data-placement AND class drawer__dialog-- (context; only --top has CSS, emit all four anyway). Dialog size/radius key on the dialog [data-placement]: bottom/top = w-full max-h-[85vh] with the two outer corners rounded; left/right = h-full w-80 sm:w-96 max-w-[85vw] square. Recommended style="--visual-viewport-height:100dvh" on the backdrop (inherited; CSS h-(--visual-viewport-height) on backdrop and content, both are fixed inset-0 so they still fill the viewport if it is missing). variant is on Backdrop; no size prop. Handle:
; the inner div MUST carry data-slot=drawer-handle-bar (CSS h-1 w-9 bg-separator). Put it first for bottom/left/right (.drawer__handle + header/body mt-0) and last for top (.drawer__dialog--top pb-2, handle pb-0) (inferred from CSS). Trigger is a real

propTargets.placement: Content (also drives Dialog class drawer__dialog--<placement> via context; data-placement goes on Content and Dialog)

Drawer.openQuestions: Drawer.Backdrop isDismissable (default true) cascades to Dialog through context and only toggles drag handlers (behavior).

Popover.notes:
Static markup: div.popover__trigger[role=button][tabindex=0][data-slot=popover-trigger] (inline-block; React wraps the trigger in it; Pressable adds tabindex, DialogTrigger adds id, aria-expanded and aria-controls while open, no aria-haspopup) and the floating div.popover (the RAC Popover element; React portals it to ) > section.popover__dialog[role=dialog][tabindex=-1][aria-labelledby=][id=][data-slot=popover-dialog] > h2.popover__heading[slot=title][id] (no data-slot) + content. If Popover.Dialog is omitted, RAC puts role=dialog tabindex=-1 on .popover itself. .popover has p-0 (padding comes from .popover__dialog p-4). CSS provides NO positioning: RAC inlines style="position:absolute; z-index:100000; top/left:; max-height:" plus --trigger-anchor-point:"px px" (transform-origin only) and --trigger-width (unused by .popover); the author positions it by hand. Write data-placement=top|bottom|left|right on .popover (RAC-resolved axis; prop default bottom, offset 8): CSS rotates [data-slot=popover-overlay-arrow] by it (bottom 180deg, left -90deg, right 90deg, top 0) and picks the enter slide. RAC also sets data-trigger=DialogTrigger and, for modal popovers, a transparent fixed inset-0 underlay (not needed statically). Optional arrow (Popover.Arrow, only when used):
aria-hidden=true role=presentation style="position:absolute; transform:translateX(-50%) (translateY(-50%) for left/right); :100%; left:px (top:px for left/right)">
; arrow fill comes from CSS keyed on data-slot=popover-overlay-arrow (the svg must carry it); the wrapper has no class. data-entering/data-exiting="true" only drive animation (omit statically). Trigger focus ring only via data-focus-visible="true"; disabled via [aria-disabled=true] or :disabled.
Popover.openQuestions: Heading has no data-slot in React; .popover__heading class is the only hook.

Tooltip.notes:
Static markup: div.tooltip__trigger[role=button][tabindex=0][data-slot=tooltip-trigger] (inline-block; React wraps the trigger content in it; tabindex comes from useFocusable) and, when shown, div.tooltip[role=tooltip][id][data-placement=top|bottom|left|right] (React portals it to ); the trigger gets aria-describedby= while open. .tooltip is max-w-xs p-2 text-xs break-all with no positioning: RAC inlines style="position:absolute; z-index:100000; top/left:; max-height:" plus --trigger-anchor-point:"px px" (transform-origin only); the author positions it by hand. Default placement is top, offset 3 (7 when showArrow). data-placement must be written on .tooltip: CSS rotates [data-slot=overlay-arrow] by it (bottom 180deg, left -90deg, right 90deg, top 0) and picks the enter slide. Arrow (Tooltip.Arrow; React default showArrow=false so usually absent), a child of .tooltip:
aria-hidden=true role=presentation style="position:absolute; transform:translateX(-50%) (translateY(-50%) for left/right); :100%; left:px (top:px for left/right)">
; arrow fill/stroke CSS is keyed on data-slot=overlay-arrow (NOT popover-overlay-arrow); wrapper data-slot=tooltip-arrow has no CSS. Open/close delays come from the :root CSS vars --tooltip-delay (1.5s) and --tooltip-close-delay (.5s), read by JS only. data-entering/data-exiting="true" only drive animation (omit statically). Hover/focus-triggered opening cannot be reproduced statically; a visible tooltip is just the .tooltip element. Trigger focus ring only via data-focus-visible="true".

Toast.notes: Root part Toast IS the .toast element; Toast.Queue and Toast.toast() are non-DOM APIs. Static markup: div.toast-region.toast-region--<placement>[data-slot=toast-region][role=region][aria-label=Notifications][tabindex=-1] style="--toast-width:460px" (fixed z-50 pointer-events-none; width calc(100vw-2rem), sm:min-w-(--toast-width); React also inlines --gap:12px, --placement, --scale-factor:.05, unused by CSS) > ol > li (both display:contents, layout-neutral) > div.toast.toast--<placement>.toast--<variant>[data-slot=toast][role=alertdialog][aria-modal=false][tabindex=0][data-index=<i>][data-frontmost=true] > div.toast__indicator[data-slot=toast-indicator] + div.toast__content[data-slot=toast-content] (> span.toast__title[slot=title][data-slot=toast-title] + span.toast__description[slot=description][data-slot=toast-description]) + action + button.close-button.close-button--default.toast__close-button[data-slot=toast-close][aria-label=Close][slot=close] (its svg needs data-slot=close-button-icon: CSS sizes it). Action = HeroUI Button with extra class toast__action and data-slot=toast-action-button: after .toast__content on desktop, inside .toast__content after the description on mobile (<=768px). Placement is written twice and must match: region toast-region--bottom|bottom-start|bottom-end|top|top-start|top-end (spaces become hyphens) and each toast toast--<same>. REQUIRED STATE: data-frontmost="true" on the front toast, otherwise .toast gets pointer-events none, overflow hidden, height var(--front-height) and hides its close button; data-hidden="true" (opacity 0) for index >= 3 (default max visible). The close button is opacity 0 / pointer-events none until .toast[data-frontmost=true]:hover; to show it statically add inline opacity:1;pointer-events:auto (no data attribute does it). .toast is position:absolute left:0 right:0 (bottom:0 for bottom placements, top:0 for top) inside the zero-height region, so stacking comes from React inline styles at queue index i: scale:(1-0.05*i); translate:"0 <+-12*i>px 0" (negative for bottom, positive for top); z-index:(count-i); opacity:(hidden?0:1); pointer-events:(hidden?none:auto); --front-height:<front toast height px> (read by .toast:not([data-frontmost=true])); without them several toasts overlap exactly. Variants: toast--accent|success|warning|danger recolor the title (and indicator for success/warning/danger); React also emits toast--default (no CSS). Indicator default icon svg[data-slot=toast-default-icon] (16x16, CSS box-content size-4): default/accent = Info, success = check-circle, warning = triangle, danger = circle-exclamation; Indicator takes its own variant prop only to pick that icon. Loading: indicator holds span.spinner.spinner--current.spinner--sm[data-slot=spinner] > svg[data-slot=spinner-icon][viewBox="0 0 24 24"] (CSS size-4 on both). Enter/exit slide uses document.startViewTransition (view-transition-class toast-bottom/toast-top): not reproducible statically.

propTargets.placement: Provider (region class; cascades to each Toast via context to give toast--<placement>)
propTargets.variant: Root (the Toast element; Indicator takes variant too, only to choose its default icon)

Toast.openQuestions: generatorDraft.parts has a lowercase key 'toast' (imperative toast() helper) and Queue: both non-DOM, null is correct. The Root Toast part is not listed in parts but maps to class 'toast'.

Dropdown.notes: Dropdown root is RAC MenuTrigger: renders NO DOM. The .dropdown class (flex flex-col gap-1) exists in CSS and as tv root slot but React never applies it (optional wrapper div). Trigger: Dropdown.Trigger renders <button type=button class=dropdown__trigger data-slot=dropdown-trigger aria-haspopup=true aria-expanded=false|true> (aria-controls while open; id); the usual pattern puts a HeroUI Button directly inside Dropdown instead (no dropdown__trigger class; the CSS comment says the class only shows for a custom trigger). Open popover (React portals to <body>): div.dropdown__popover[data-slot=dropdown-popover][data-placement=bottom|top|left|right][data-trigger=MenuTrigger][role=dialog][tabindex=-1] (RAC inline: position:absolute; z-index:100000; top/left/max-height px; --trigger-anchor-point; --trigger-width unused by CSS; the author positions it) > div.dropdown__menu[role=menu][data-slot=dropdown-menu][aria-labelledby=<trigger id>][data-selection-mode=single|multiple, only when selectionMode is set] > items. The data-slot values are REQUIRED because the CSS selects them: .dropdown__popover [data-slot=dropdown-menu] {p-1.5}, .dropdown__popover [data-slot=menu-item] {px-2.5}, .dropdown__menu [data-slot=separator] {94% wide, centered} (HeroUI Separator carries data-slot=separator). Items = MenuItem entry (div.menu-item[data-slot=menu-item][role=menuitem|menuitemradio|menuitemcheckbox][tabindex=-1]), groups = MenuSection (section.menu-section[role=group] > header.header[data-slot=header]); Dropdown.ItemIndicator and Dropdown.SubmenuIndicator are MenuItem indicators. Submenu: Dropdown.SubmenuTrigger has no DOM; its trigger item needs aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded=true|false, data-has-submenu="true" (+ data-open="true" while open) and a span.menu-item__indicator.menu-item__indicator--submenu[data-slot=submenu-indicator][aria-hidden=true] holding a chevron-right svg; the submenu is a second .dropdown__popover. Trigger states: [data-pressed=true] or :active scale .97; [data-pending=true] pending; disabled = :disabled or [aria-disabled=true]; focus ring only via data-focus-visible="true" (:focus-visible:not(:focus) cannot match natively). data-entering/data-exiting="true" only animate. Popover width: max-w-[48svw], md:min-w-55.
Dropdown.openQuestions: Popover role=dialog is inferred from RAC Popover.mjs logic (no nested [role=dialog] => isDialog), not from a DOM capture.

Menu.notes: Standalone menu (no popover): div.menu[role=menu][data-slot=menu][aria-label|aria-labelledby] (relative flex flex-col gap-1 overflow-clip p-1; RAC adds data-empty="true" when it has no items). Children: Menu.Item (div.menu-item[data-slot=menu-item], see MenuItem), Menu.Section (section.menu-section, see MenuSection), and separators carrying data-slot=separator (CSS .menu [data-slot=separator] {ml 3%; w 94%}). Menu.ItemIndicator = MenuItem indicator. No tv variants/props. selectionMode (none|single|multiple) is a RAC prop with no CSS of its own: it decides item roles (menuitemradio for single, menuitemcheckbox for multiple), aria-checked and data-selection-mode on each item, all written by hand. Inside a dropdown use the Dropdown block instead (class dropdown__menu, data-slot=dropdown-menu), because the .dropdown__popover padding rules key on that data-slot.

MenuItem.notes: Element: div.menu-item[data-slot=menu-item][tabindex=-1][role=menuitem | menuitemradio (parent selectionMode single) | menuitemcheckbox (multiple)]; tv emits menu-item--default (no CSS) or menu-item--danger (variant is a Root prop). Inner label/description must carry data-slot: <span class="label" data-slot=label> and <span class="description" data-slot=description> (CSS: pointer-events none, select-none; danger recolors [data-slot=label]); a Kbd child is also allowed. State attrs by hand: disabled needs data-disabled="true" (+aria-disabled=true): the CSS has no :disabled / aria-disabled rule for menu-item; selected = aria-checked="true" (RAC writes aria-checked on radio/checkbox items) or aria-selected="true" or data-selected="true"; data-selection-mode="multiple" on the item only changes indicator transitions; hover (@media hover) / :active / data-hovered / data-pressed have native equivalents; focus ring only via data-focus-visible="true" (:focus-visible:not(:focus) cannot match natively); data-focused and data-open are set by RAC but unstyled. Submenu trigger item: data-has-submenu="true" aria-haspopup=menu aria-expanded=true|false (padding becomes pe-7 ps-2 and any .menu-item__indicator jumps to inline-end). An item holding an indicator gets ps-7 via :has(.menu-item__indicator). Indicator (MenuItem.Indicator / Menu.ItemIndicator / Dropdown.ItemIndicator; prop type = checkmark (default) | dot selects the svg): span.menu-item__indicator[data-slot=menu-item-indicator][data-type=checkmark|dot][aria-hidden=true][data-visible=true when selected; unused by CSS] (absolute start-2, size-4). Checkmark svg: data-slot=menu-item-indicator--checkmark viewBox="0 0 17 18" fill=none stroke=currentColor stroke-width=2 stroke-linecap=round stroke-linejoin=round stroke-dasharray=22 stroke-dashoffset=66 (unselected, hidden) or 44 (selected, visible) role=presentation aria-hidden=true > polyline points="1 9 7 14 15 4". The CSS never sets dasharray/dashoffset: they are SVG attributes React writes, so the author must write them. Dot svg: data-slot=menu-item-indicator--dot viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill=currentColor role=presentation aria-hidden=true > path fill-rule=evenodd clip-rule=evenodd d="M8 15A7 7 0 1 0 8 1a7 7 0 0 0 0 14"; CSS keeps it opacity-0 scale-70 until the item has aria-checked/aria-selected/data-selected="true". SubmenuIndicator (rendered only for items with a submenu): span.menu-item__indicator.menu-item__indicator--submenu[data-slot=submenu-indicator][aria-hidden=true] > chevron-right svg 16x16 (CSS sizes svg to size-3).

propTargets.type: Indicator (checkmark | dot; chooses the svg and data-type, not a class)

MenuSection.notes: section.menu-section (flex flex-col items-start gap-0). RAC adds role=group and aria-labelledby=<header id> (or aria-label). First child is the section title: <header class="header" data-slot=header role=presentation id=...> (HeroUI Header: w-full px-2 pt-1.5 pb-1 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted); the menu items follow as direct children. Separators between sections are siblings carrying data-slot=separator. A section can take its own selectionMode (RAC), which scopes role/aria-checked of its items. No props, variants or state attributes. Used by both Menu.Section and Dropdown.Section (same component; the class is always menu-section).

ListBox.notes: div.list-box[role=listbox][data-slot=list-box][tabindex][aria-label|aria-labelledby][data-layout=stack][data-orientation=vertical][aria-multiselectable=true only for multiple selection] (relative w-full overflow-clip p-1). tv also emits list-box--default / list-box--danger but NO CSS rule exists for either, so the Root variant has no visual effect in 3.2.1. Items, sections and separators must be DIRECT children: spacing is .list-box > * + * {margin-top:.25rem}, not flex gap. Separator needs data-slot=separator AND data-orientation=horizontal (CSS ml 3% / w 94%; vertical not styled); the data-orientation=horizontal in generator stateAttrs belongs to that separator, not to the listbox root. RAC adds data-empty="true" when empty; the empty state is custom content wrapped by RAC in div[role=option] style display:contents (static: write your own). Inside Select/ComboBox/Autocomplete popovers the host block styles the list through [data-slot=list-box] and [data-slot=list-box-item] (padding; max-height in Autocomplete), so those data-slot values are required there. Items = ListBoxItem entry, groups = ListBoxSection. RAC also sets data-focused/data-focus-visible on the root (unstyled).

propTargets.variant: Root (list-box--danger/--default are emitted but have no CSS)

ListBoxItem.notes: div.list-box-item[role=option][data-slot=list-box-item][tabindex][aria-selected=true|false (RAC writes it whenever selectionMode != none)][data-selection-mode=single|multiple]; tv emits list-box-item--default (no CSS) or list-box-item--danger (variant is a Root prop; danger recolors the indicator and [data-slot=label]). State attrs by hand: disabled = data-disabled="true" (+aria-disabled=true): no :disabled/aria-disabled rule exists; selected = aria-selected="true" or data-selected="true", but the CSS rule for that state is empty, so the only visible selected cue is the Indicator checkmark (stroke-dashoffset); hover (@media hover) / :active have native equivalents (data-hovered, data-pressed to force); focus ring only via data-focus-visible="true" (:focus-visible:not(:focus) cannot match natively). Label/description children must carry data-slot=label / data-slot=description (CSS pointer-events none, select-none, w-fit label). Indicator (ListBox.ItemIndicator): span.list-box-item__indicator[data-slot=list-box-item-indicator][aria-hidden=true][data-visible=true when selected; unused by CSS] (absolute end-2 size-4; the item gets pe-7 via :has(.list-box-item__indicator)) > svg[data-slot=list-box-item-indicator--checkmark][viewBox="0 0 17 18"][fill=none][stroke=currentColor][stroke-width=2][stroke-linecap=round][stroke-linejoin=round][stroke-dasharray=22][stroke-dashoffset=66 (unselected, hidden) | 44 (selected, visible)][role=presentation][aria-hidden=true] > polyline points="1 9 7 14 15 4". dasharray/dashoffset are SVG attributes that React sets and the CSS never sets: the author must write them. Inside .select__value and .autocomplete__value the indicator is display:none. The selected-state transition rule in the compiled CSS is mis-nested (.list-box-item__indicator .list-box-item[...]) and never applies.

ListBoxSection.notes: section.list-box-section (flex flex-col items-start gap-0). RAC adds role=group and aria-labelledby=<header id> (or aria-label). First child is the title: <header class="header" data-slot=header role=presentation id=...> (HeroUI Header: w-full px-2 pt-1.5 pb-1 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted), then the ListBox items as direct children. Spacing between siblings comes from the parent .list-box > * + * margin-top, so keep the section a direct child of .list-box. No props, variants or state attributes.

Select.notes: Root: div.select.select--<primary|secondary>[.select--full-width][data-slot=select] (flex flex-col gap-1) containing Label (class label, data-slot=label), Select.Trigger, Description (data-slot=description; hidden by CSS when root has data-invalid or aria-invalid=true), FieldError, and the popover. RAC also renders a visually-hidden native <select> (HiddenSelect, form support only; optional). Root state attrs (RAC): data-open, data-disabled, data-invalid, data-focused, data-focus-visible, data-required; the CSS keys on root [data-invalid=true] or [aria-invalid=true] (danger outline + field-focus bg on the trigger). Trigger: <button type=button class="select__trigger [select__trigger--full-width]" data-slot=select-trigger aria-haspopup=listbox aria-expanded=false|true> (RAC Button, NOT a HeroUI Button) containing span.select__value[data-slot=select-value][data-placeholder=true when nothing selected] and the indicator. Trigger states: disabled via :disabled, data-disabled="true" or aria-disabled="true" on the TRIGGER (not the root); hover via :hover/data-hovered; focus ring only via data-focus-visible="true" (:focus-visible:not(:focus) cannot match natively). Indicator default: svg.select__indicator[data-slot=select-default-indicator][data-open=true when open -> rotate 180deg] chevron-down (viewBox "0 0 16 16" width/height 16 aria-hidden role=presentation; path d="M2.97 5.47a.75.75 0 0 1 1.06 0L8 9.44l3.97-3.97a.75.75 0 1 1 1.06 1.06l-4.5 4.5a.75.75 0 0 1-1.06 0l-4.5-4.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.06" fill=currentColor); a custom child indicator instead gets class select__indicator, data-slot=select-indicator and data-open. The indicator is absolutely positioned (end-2 inset-y-0); trigger pe-7 comes from :has(.select__indicator). When an item is selected RAC renders that item children inside the value; statically write plain text (CSS hides [data-slot=list-box-item-indicator] inside .select__value). Popover (portaled): div.select__popover[data-slot=select-popover][data-placement=bottom][role=dialog][tabindex=-1] with RAC inline position:absolute; z-index:100000; top/left/max-height px; --trigger-anchor-point; --trigger-width:<trigger width px> (CSS min-width:var(--trigger-width): set it or the popover can be narrower than the trigger). It holds a ListBox (data-slot=list-box -> p-1.5; items need data-slot=list-box-item -> px-2.5; add aria-multiselectable=true on the listbox for multi-select, otherwise indicator transitions are disabled). Selected item = aria-selected=true plus checkmark stroke-dashoffset=44 (see ListBoxItem). data-entering/data-exiting only animate.

propTargets.fullWidth: Root (also adds select__trigger--full-width on Trigger via context)
propTargets.variant: Root (select--secondary restyles .select__trigger through a descendant selector)

Select.openQuestions: Popover role=dialog is inferred from RAC Popover.mjs logic, not from a DOM capture.

Autocomplete.notes: Built from RAC Select + Autocomplete filter (searchable select). Root: div.autocomplete.autocomplete--<primary|secondary>[.autocomplete--full-width][data-slot=autocomplete] (flex flex-col gap-1; Label/Description/FieldError as in Select; root data-invalid="true" or aria-invalid="true" drives the invalid trigger style). Trigger is NOT a button: div.autocomplete__trigger[.autocomplete__trigger--full-width][role=group][data-slot=autocomplete-trigger] (RAC Group; data-hovered/data-focus-visible/data-focus-within/data-disabled/data-invalid; disabled = data-disabled="true" or aria-disabled="true", :disabled cannot match a div; focus ring only via data-focus-visible="true") holding span.autocomplete__value[data-slot=autocomplete-value][data-placeholder=true when empty], optional ClearButton, and Indicator. ClearButton: <button aria-label="Clear selection" class=autocomplete__clear-button data-slot=autocomplete-clear-button data-empty="true" [disabled]> with svg[data-slot=autocomplete-clear-button-icon] (Close icon, viewBox "0 0 16 16"; the data-slot is required, CSS size-3.5); data-empty="true" = nothing selected -> opacity 0 + pointer-events none (omit the attribute to show it). Indicator default: <button type=button aria-haspopup=listbox aria-expanded> (RAC Button consuming the Select trigger context; no HeroUI classes) wrapping svg.autocomplete__indicator[data-slot=autocomplete-default-indicator][data-open=true when open -> rotate 180deg] chevron-down 16x16 (absolute end-2; trigger pe-7 via :has(.autocomplete__indicator)); a custom child gets data-slot=autocomplete-indicator. Popover (portaled): div.autocomplete__popover[data-slot=autocomplete-popover][data-placement=bottom] with RAC inline position:absolute; z-index:100000; top/left/max-height; --trigger-anchor-point, plus React inline --trigger-width:<trigger offsetWidth px> (CSS w and max-w = var(--trigger-width), pt-2, overflow-hidden: set it). It auto-renders an inner section.autocomplete__popover-dialog[role=dialog][data-slot=autocomplete-popover-dialog][tabindex=-1] (no separate public part; the popover itself then has no role) holding the author content: a SearchField (root must carry data-slot=search-field: px-3 py-1), a ListBox (data-slot=list-box: max-h-[320px] overflow-y-auto p-1.5; items need data-slot=list-box-item; aria-multiselectable=true on the listbox for multi-select), and an optional empty-state element data-slot=empty-state (text-center text-sm). Autocomplete.Filter renders NO DOM (RAC filter wrapper); autocomplete__filter exists in the tv slots but is never emitted and has no CSS. Selected item look: see ListBoxItem (aria-selected + checkmark dashoffset 44).

propTargets.fullWidth: Root (also adds autocomplete__trigger--full-width on Trigger via context)
propTargets.variant: Root (autocomplete--secondary restyles .autocomplete__trigger through a descendant selector)

Autocomplete.openQuestions: autocomplete__popover-dialog has no part entry; documented as an implicit inner element of Popover.

ComboBox.notes: Root: div.combo-box[.combo-box--full-width][data-slot=combo-box] (flex flex-col gap-1; RAC adds data-open/data-focused/data-disabled/data-invalid). Children: Label (class label, data-slot=label); div.combo-box__input-group[.combo-box__input-group--full-width][data-slot=combo-box-input-group] (relative isolate inline-flex; a plain div, not a RAC Group); Description/FieldError ([data-slot=description] is hidden when root has data-invalid="true" or aria-invalid="true"). Inside the input group: HeroUI Input = <input class="input input--primary|input--secondary" data-slot=input role=combobox aria-expanded aria-autocomplete=list aria-controls> and ComboBox.Trigger = <button type=button class=combo-box__trigger data-slot=combo-box-trigger tabindex=-1 aria-label="Show suggestions" data-open=true when open>. The input MUST carry data-slot=input: CSS .combo-box [data-slot=input] gives min-w-0 flex-1, focused-field styles on :focus / [data-focus], disabled styles, and pe-7 only when the trigger is its IMMEDIATE next sibling (:has(+ .combo-box__trigger)). The trigger is absolute end-0 top-1/2 h-full; default content svg[data-slot=combo-box-trigger-default-icon] chevron-down 16x16 (size-4; rotates 180deg when the TRIGGER has data-open="true": data-open sits on the button here, not on the svg). Trigger states: :hover/data-hovered, [data-pressed=true] opacity-70, disabled via :disabled, data-disabled or aria-disabled; focus ring only via data-focus-visible="true" (:focus-visible:not(:focus) cannot match natively). Popover (portaled): div.combo-box__popover[data-slot=combo-box-popover][data-placement=bottom] with RAC inline position:absolute; z-index:100000; top/left/max-height; --trigger-anchor-point; --trigger-width = pixel width spanning input + trigger button (RAC computes it because no RAC Group is rendered; CSS min-width:var(--trigger-width): set it). No role=dialog (RAC isNonModal). It contains a ListBox (data-slot=list-box -> p-1.5; items need data-slot=list-box-item -> px-2.5; single-select so the checkmark has no transition); selected item = aria-selected + checkmark stroke-dashoffset=44 (see ListBoxItem). Prop menuTrigger defaults to "focus" (behavior only).

propTargets.fullWidth: Root (also adds combo-box__input-group--full-width on InputGroup via context)
propTargets.variant: Root (cascades through ComboBoxContext to the child Input as input--primary|input--secondary; adds no combo-box class)

ComboBox.openQuestions: ComboBox variant prop is not in generatorDraft.props because the combo-box tv has none; it is only forwarded to Input.

ColorPicker.notes: Root: div.color-picker[data-slot=color-picker] (inline-flex; RAC ColorPicker and DialogTrigger render no DOM of their own). Trigger: <button type=button class=color-picker__trigger data-slot=color-picker-trigger aria-expanded=false|true> (RAC Button inside DialogTrigger: id, aria-expanded, aria-controls while open, no aria-haspopup; inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-sm text-sm), typically containing a ColorSwatch and a Label (class label, data-slot=label; CSS gives it the interactive cursor). Trigger states: disabled via :disabled, data-disabled="true" or aria-disabled="true"; focus ring only via data-focus-visible="true" (:focus-visible:not(:focus) cannot match natively). Popover (portaled): div.color-picker__popover[data-slot=color-picker-popover][data-placement=bottom|top|left|right][role=dialog][tabindex=-1] (flex-col gap-3, min-w-62, overflow-y-auto; default placement prop "bottom left", RAC resolves data-placement to the axis; CSS matches it with ^=) with RAC inline position:absolute; z-index:100000; top/left/max-height px; --trigger-anchor-point (transform-origin only); the author positions it. It holds ColorArea / ColorSlider / ColorField / ColorSwatchPicker children. In React the picker state feeds those children their color via context; statically each child needs its own explicit color styling (see their entries). data-entering/data-exiting="true" only animate. role=dialog inferred from RAC Popover.mjs logic (no nested dialog).
ColorPicker.openQuestions: Child-component color inlining (ColorSwatch --color etc.) belongs to those components' entries and was not verified here.
